method: Claude target = multiple x next-fiscal-year consensus EPS (Yahoo Finance consensus feed, LSEG/S&P Global data); prices = latest full-session close available on the morning of the as-of date, New York time (1 Oct 2026 for US and European listings, 2 Oct 2026 for Tokyo, Seoul, Taipei and Hong Kong, 30 Sep 2026 for mainland China).

power.name: HD Hyundai Electric
power.theme: Extra-high-voltage transformers, built in the US

power.name: Infineon Technologies
power.theme: Power semiconductors for every stage of an 800 V hall

power.name: Delta Electronics
power.theme: Rack power, 800 V systems, battery backup, solid-state transformers

power.name: Lite-On Technology
power.theme: Number two in AI rack power and GPU power smoothing

power.name: Powell Industries
power.theme: Engineered medium-voltage switchgear and power rooms

power.name: onsemi
power.theme: Silicon carbide and power devices with operating leverage

power.name: INNIO
power.theme: Gas engines for onsite prime power

power.name: Flex
power.theme: Rack power systems, with a spin-off catalyst

power.name: LS Corp
power.theme: Korean holding company: HVDC cable, magnet wire, LS Electric

power.name: Vicor
power.theme: Vertical power delivery patents: real physics, binary outcome

power.name: Eaton
power.why: The best-placed US incumbent: an IEC-certified medium-voltage solid-state transformer, Bussmann DC fuses and Boyd liquid cooling. Americas electrical orders were +41% [P1-89].

power.name: ABB
power.why: Holds the first IEC-certified solid-state DC breaker (SACE Infinitus), a medium-voltage UPS and a stake in DG Matrix, but trades at about 27× 2027 earnings, and consensus is "hold". ABB sold its power-grids business to Hitachi in 2020–22, so it is not an HVDC supplier.

power.name: Vertiv
power.why: A real 800 V portfolio (rack and pod in 2027, hall in 2028) and leadership in liquid cooling, but a consensus favorite whose central-UPS franchise faces the 2028+ mix shift.

power.name: GE Vernova
power.why: Turbines are sold out to 2029–30, but the stock trades at about 40× 2027 earnings. Its 2026 earnings are inflated by a gain of about $4 billion on Prolec, and industry turbine capacity roughly doubles by 2030.

power.name: Schneider Electric
power.why: Triple-digit data-center growth is already in its 24× multiple, and it has no shipping 800 V switchboard or solid-state transformer yet.

power.name: Hitachi (Hitachi Energy)
power.why: The broadest owner of the scarce high-voltage stack (about 1 in 6 of the world's transformers, 1 in 4 high-voltage switchgear, more than 175 GW of HVDC links), but the stock is only about 5% below its high [P3-8].

power.name: Caterpillar
power.why: The broadest onsite-power seller (diesel generator sets, gas engines and the gas turbines of its Solar Turbines unit), with engine orders running into 2030. It is diversified across mining and construction and trades at about 26× 2027 earnings.

power.name: Prysmian
power.why: The HVDC-cable oligopoly is running "flat out" with "no pricing pressure", but it is fully recognized, and the pending Atkore deal dilutes quality [P3-69].

power.name: Nexans
power.why: The value member of the cable oligopoly, at about 14.5× 2027 earnings with a €7.7 billion transmission backlog [P3-72]. It is not a top pick because its AI exposure is indirect, through grid connections.

power.name: Quanta Services
power.why: The undisputed leader in transmission construction, priced at about 34× 2027 earnings.

power.name: MYR Group
power.why: The cheapest pure electrical contractor with transmission leverage, about 41% below its high. Its transmission revenue has not yet inflected.

power.name: Cummins
power.why: Its large QSK95 engines are sold out into the second half of 2028, and it expects more than $9 billion of data-center exposure by 2030, mostly diesel standby. At about 15× 2027 earnings it is cheap, but trucks still dominate its earnings.

power.name: Generac
power.why: An agreement to supply Amazon's data centers with backup generators worth up to $8 billion, of which about $2.4 billion is scheduled for 2027–28. Amazon received warrants on about 1.69 million Generac shares that vest as it buys [X-17]. The residential business remains cyclical.

power.name: Bloom Energy
power.why: The only onsite option at gigawatt scale that does not burn its fuel: its fuel cells convert natural gas to electricity chemically. Oracle has committed to 2.4 GW for its Project Jupiter campus in New Mexico and reaffirmed that on 25 September 2026, after it sent the site's developer a force-majeure notice (a contractual warning that events outside its control may delay the project). The stock trades at about 56× 2027 earnings, and gas-pipeline and air permits now limit deployments [X-16].

power.name: Monolithic Power Systems
power.why: An excellent franchise (data-center revenue +164%), but it trades at about 39× 2027 earnings and is named in two of Vicor's ITC cases [P1-42].

power.name: LS Electric
power.why: It holds the UL 1,500 V DC breaker credential, but at about 41× 2027 earnings the cheaper route is through its parent, LS Corp.

power.name: Doosan Enerbility
power.why: Twelve large H-class gas turbines for xAI, but about 78× 2027 earnings and heavy dependence on one buyer.

power.name: Navitas Semiconductor
power.why: Loss-making on about $10–14 million of quarterly revenue, with 800 V revenue expected from 2027. It is an option, not an investment case.

power.name: Wolfspeed
power.why: Runs a −20% gross margin on an adjusted (non-GAAP) basis [P2-23]. Management says it needs an annual revenue run-rate of about $800 million to break even at the gross-margin level [P2-25], against about $600 million at the latest quarterly rate (my estimate).

power.name: Samsung Electro-Mechanics
power.why: Capacitors for AI power are real, but the stock is up about 520% this year and fell about 11% on the Kyber-delay report alone.

power.name: Fluence Energy
power.why: Data-center batteries are an under-modelled demand spike, but Fluence has had two guidance cuts, a failed manufacturing ramp and class actions.

power.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
power.why: It is the only US maker of grain-oriented electrical steel, but electrical and stainless steel are only about 4% of its volume, so it is a steel-cycle stock, not an AI-scarcity owner [P3-37].

interconnects.name: Mitsui Kinzoku (Mitsui Mining & Smelting)
interconnects.theme: Ultra-smooth copper foil for 224G boards and IC substrates

interconnects.name: Sumitomo Electric Industries
interconnects.theme: InP substrates, lasers, optical connectors and fiber

interconnects.name: Broadcom
interconnects.theme: Switch silicon, co-packaged optics, lasers, custom accelerators

interconnects.name: Coherent
interconnects.theme: 6-inch InP lasers, light sources for co-packaged optics, transceivers

interconnects.name: TSMC
interconnects.theme: COUPE co-packaged optics, SoIC 3D stacking, CoWoS

interconnects.name: JX Advanced Metals
interconnects.theme: InP substrates and semiconductor sputtering targets

interconnects.name: BE Semiconductor Industries (Besi)
interconnects.theme: Hybrid bonding and photonics die attach

interconnects.name: Nittobo (Nitto Boseki)
interconnects.theme: Low-expansion T-glass and low-loss glass cloth

interconnects.name: Credo Technology
interconnects.theme: Active electrical cables, retimers and optical signal processors

interconnects.name: Lumentum
interconnects.why: The highest-quality InP franchise: one of two 200G modulated-laser suppliers with Broadcom, ultra-high-power lasers for co-packaged optics, and pump lasers sold out. It trades within 1% of its high at about 48× fiscal 2027 and 30× fiscal 2028 earnings.

interconnects.name: Ciena
interconnects.why: Coherent optics and line systems for data-center interconnect. Fiscal Q3 revenue rose 37% and fiscal 2026 guidance is $6.42 billion, but two customers are 41.7% of revenue [X-1].

interconnects.name: Corning
interconnects.why: Fiber and connectivity: optical sales +32% and enterprise +65% on generative-AI products in Q2 2026, with its Springboard targets (raised in May) reaffirmed [X-2]. It trades at about 37× 2027 earnings.

interconnects.name: Fujikura
interconnects.why: High-density fiber and cable for AI data centers; already re-rated.

interconnects.name: Marvell
interconnects.why: Owns Celestial AI's Photonic Fabric (optical scale-up and optics into memory) plus optical signal processors and custom silicon, at about 40× fiscal 2028 earnings. Investor Day is on 6 October.

interconnects.name: Arista Networks
interconnects.why: The scale-out Ethernet leader, near its high at about 39× 2027 earnings.

interconnects.name: Amphenol
interconnects.why: A connector franchise that does not depend on the medium (copper, fiber and power). Rubin's cable-less tray removed some exclusive content.

interconnects.name: Tower Semiconductor
interconnects.why: The merchant silicon-photonics foundry leader (run-rate $680 million, heading above $1 billion in Q4 2026), but at about 36× 2027 earnings, and four 300 mm silicon-photonics expansions converge in 2027–29 [I2-58].

interconnects.name: Soitec
interconnects.why: Reportedly about 95% of 300 mm photonics silicon-on-insulator wafers (a secondary estimate) [I2-61], with that revenue growing 2.5–3× in fiscal 2027 [I2-62]. The stock is up about 580% this year, and consensus sits at about the current price.

interconnects.name: Elite Material
interconnects.why: The number one high-speed laminate maker (about 39% share) [I3-62]. It is up 215% this year and squeezed between foil and glass suppliers that have pricing power.

interconnects.name: Fabrinet
interconnects.why: About 40% below its high after NVIDIA fell to 16% of fiscal 2026 revenue [X-3]. Co-packaged optics moves optical-engine assembly toward TSMC and Foxconn, but Fabrinet is a non-Chinese manufacturing route if US rules tighten.

interconnects.name: Celestica
interconnects.why: Switch and rack integration at about 19× 2027 earnings; named in Vicor's September 2026 patent complaint at the US International Trade Commission.

interconnects.name: InnoLight (Zhongji Innolight)
interconnects.why: The world's largest 800G / 1.6T transceiver maker (first-half 2026 net profit CN¥13.65 billion) at only about 12× 2027 earnings. It is cheap for a reason: it was added to the Pentagon's 1260H list on 8 June 2026, and a Treasury listing would bar US persons from holding it [X-4][X-5]. Figures use the Shenzhen line (15 analysts); the Hong Kong line (HK$1,072 on 2 October) has only three analyst targets.

interconnects.name: Astera Labs
interconnects.why: Excellent scale-up position, but about 56× 2027 earnings and 20× 2027 sales, already past the bull case.

interconnects.name: AXT
interconnects.why: InP substrate leverage, but all crystal growth is in China, US-customer export permits are pending, and the stock trades at about 36× 2027 earnings [I2-21].

interconnects.name: POET Technologies
interconnects.why: An optical-interposer story valued at $1.3 billion on about $1.7 million of trailing revenue; its Marvell partnership ended.

interconnects.name: Lightwave Logic
interconnects.why: Electro-optic polymers valued at $0.8 billion on about $0.25 million of trailing revenue; long-term polymer reliability is unproven.

interconnects.name: SKC (Absolics glass core)
interconnects.why: Glass-core substrate mass production pushed to 2027; loss-making [I3-70].

interconnects.name: Applied Optoelectronics
interconnects.why: A transceiver maker that lost about $57 million over the last twelve months [I2-78]. Consensus expects a turn to profit in 2027, and after a 208% rise this year the shares already trade at about 23× those 2027 earnings.
